changes.comment: Add quantity formatting for FieldRun values in text annotations. `FieldRun.formatOptions.quantity` (`kindOfQuantity`, `persistenceUnit`, `formatSet`) drives resolution: the effective (override, override-or-property) pair is tried first, then the property-side pair. `kindOfQuantity` and `persistenceUnit` are independent overrides. A field routes through the `FormattingSpecProvider` registered for its `formatSet` when one exists, otherwise through the iModel's schema-backed formats; if neither resolves, `"quantity"` and `"coordinate"` fall back to their raw string representation.
